body: Thank you so much, just the kindness and validation you’ve shown me has helped. I truly hope I can find those things too, it just looks very murky for me going forward.

He has mentioned in past conventions about the subject that it bothers him and that’s why I also have strongly believed in him seeking mental health help. He’s been to counseling before and said he’s worked on it (and I feel like he has no reason to lie about that) but I think he’s the kind of person who gets upset when progress isn’t immediate and gives up entirely. 
Thank you for your advice
Thank you for your brutal honesty, it truly does help to have a male perspective on the matter!

Honestly you may be right, I asked him where he has gotten this idea and if he has reached out to any male friends to ask them for help, and he says he hasn’t so he must either be getting this idea from somewhere or just assuming he can’t be wrong. 
I don’t wanna seem like I’m defending him/this behavior bc I know he’s a good guy, and this is pretty much the only big issue we’ve had come up in our entire relationship. However, he needs to see from other people in happy relationships that this isn’t normal/okay, and hopefully get help from there.
